entry.title: New: Bill 92 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, DEPARTMENT OF MANAGEMENT, MANAGEMENT PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to increase the equivalent personnel for the Department of Management, Management Program by 1.0. This position would be unfunded and would allow for the creation of a Department of Hawaiian Home Lands liaison position prior to the creation of the Department of Housing in FY 2025. The bill also increases grant funding to the Maui County Veterans Council by $40,000.
